name: CAPOX (Capecitabine / OXALIplatin), adjuvant or perioperative
stage: III (resected, after D2 lymph node dissection)

biomarkers.note: CAPOX (capecitabine plus oxaliplatin) is a cytotoxic doublet and is not biomarker-restricted. HER2 and MMR or MSI status are tested to guide add-on or alternative therapy, not the doublet itself. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric Cancer v3.2026, Postoperative Chemotherapy and Principles of Biomarker Testing.

lineOfTherapy: adjuvant (postoperative) chemotherapy after curative gastrectomy with D2 lymph node dissection, or as the perioperative fluoropyrimidine-plus-oxaliplatin doublet; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: curative gastrectomy with D2 lymph node dissection completed
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 102748 to 102750 (CLASSIC: adjuvant CAPOX after D2 gastrectomy, 8 cycles over 6 months)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: stage II or III resected gastric cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, Discussion, CLASSIC trial (guidelines/gastric.txt lines 4279 to 4290)

drugs.name: OXALIplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 99169 (oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 on day 1 every 3 weeks, HER2-positive GEJ or gastric adenocarcinoma)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 99169. OXALIplatin 130 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 3 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP. See divergence note: DeVita prints this 130 mg/m2 q3w oxaliplatin dose paired with capecitabine 850 mg/m2 twice daily in the LOGiC trial context; the CLASSIC adjuvant CAPOX pairing (capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice daily) is recorded on the capecitabine entry.

drugs.name: Capecitabine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 98868 (capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice a day for 14 days, gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 98868. Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1 to 14 (this per-dose is the twice-daily dose). DPYD deficiency raises fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk; consider DPYD testing before first dose.

supportiveCare: Cycle count: 8 cycles over approximately 6 months in the adjuvant CLASSIC setting (DeVita 12th ed., line 102749).
DPYD: consider DPYD genotype or phenotype testing before capecitabine; reduce or avoid on deficiency.
Antiemetics: oxaliplatin-based, moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle (OXALIplatin)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher hand-foot syndrome or diarrhea
doseModificationRules.text: Hold capecitabine until recovery then reduce per grade; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

divergence.note: DeVita does not reprint the consolidated CLASSIC CAPOX per-drug dose table; it confirms CLASSIC adjuvant CAPOX = 8 cycles over 6 months. The oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 q3w value is taken from line 99169 and the capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice-daily value from line 98868 (both gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma contexts). A neighboring DeVita passage (LOGiC) prints 130 mg/m2 oxaliplatin paired with 850 mg/m2 capecitabine. Per-drug dose selection left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for adjuvant or perioperative CAPOX (capecitabine plus oxaliplatin) in resected gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma, grounded on the CLASSIC trial. DeVita 12th ed. (lines 102748 to 102750) establishes adjuvant CAPOX after D2 gastrectomy as 8 cycles over roughly 6 months but does not reprint a consolidated per-drug dose table; therefore oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 on day 1 every 3 weeks is grounded to line 99169 and capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1 to 14 to line 98868 (both gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma dosing lines). A divergence is recorded because a neighboring DeVita passage pairs the same 130 mg/m2 oxaliplatin with capecitabine 850 mg/m2 twice daily; per-drug dose selection is left to clinical review. Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric Cancer v3.2026 corroborates postoperative CAPOX after D2 dissection. ISMP tall-man applied (OXALIplatin). DPYD screening flagged for the fluoropyrimidine. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
